title: DPWH Davao Region submits 10 boxes of documents to NBI amid flood control probe
summary: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) - Davao Region on Thursday submitted to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) 10 boxes of documents amid investigation into flood control…

blocks.text: 𝟭𝟬 𝗦𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗔𝗚𝗘 𝗕𝗢𝗫, 𝗗𝗜𝗡𝗔𝗟𝗔 𝗦𝗔 𝗡𝗕𝗜 10 storage box mula sa Davao City Engineering Office na naglalaman ng mga dokumento ng mga proyekto, dinala sa tanggapan ng National Bureau of Investigation (NBI). | via @luisitosantos03 https://t.co/aI8y1i263O— DZBB Super Radyo (@dzbb) September 24, 2026

The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) - Davao Region on Thursday submitted to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) 10 boxes of documents amid investigation into flood control projects, according to Super Radyo dzBB's Luisito Santos.
DPWH Davao Region director Juby Cordon also appeared before the NBI.
On Monday, the NBI said the bureau has served a subpoena on the DPWH Regional Office in Davao City in connection with its investigation into alleged anomalous flood control projects.
The subpoena directed the regional director to appear before the NBI on Thursday to provide information as part of the bureau's investigation.
She was also ordered to submit documents concerning 51 flood control projects. — Joviland Rita/RSJ, GMA News
